title: CSF
description: CSF's own measurements, exported by csf serve at /metrics. Every panel's description carries the definition of each metric it queries; tools/metricpanels fails the merge path on a metric without a panel or a panel without a metric.

panels.title: Sessions by phase
panels.description: How many sessions are in each phase now. csf_sessions: Agent sessions this host holds, by phase (starting, running, open, canceling, canceled, failed, closed), read from the session service at each scrape.

panels.title: Turns per day, by agent
panels.description: Turns finished in the 24 hours before each point. csf_session_turns_total: Turns finished: the result records in each run's events.jsonl.

panels.title: Tokens per day, by kind
panels.description: Tokens the turns of the 24 hours before each point used, by kind. csf_tokens_total: Tokens by kind (uncached, cache_write, cache_read, output), summed over the per-turn usage of each run's result records.

panels.title: Spend per day, by model
panels.description: US dollars spent in the 24 hours before each point. csf_cost_usd_total: Executor-reported spend in US dollars: total_cost_usd is cumulative within one executor process, so each result record adds its rise over the previous one, or its whole value after the process restarted.

panels.title: Spend in the last 24 hours, by slice
panels.description: The ten slices and agents that spent most in the last 24 hours. csf_cost_usd_total: Executor-reported spend in US dollars: total_cost_usd is cumulative within one executor process, so each result record adds its rise over the previous one, or its whole value after the process restarted.

panels.title: Admission: worker cap and hold
panels.description: How many sessions the host admits at once, and whether housekeeping holds admission. csf_admission_worker_cap: Sessions the host admits at once, max(1, floor(cores - 1-minute load)), from the harness launch check. csf_admission_held: 1 while housekeeping holds session admission, otherwise 0.

panels.title: Free disk against the admission floor
panels.description: Free disk and the floor below which the launch check fails. csf_admission_free_disk_bytes: Free bytes on the state directory's filesystem, from the harness launch check. csf_admission_disk_floor_bytes: Free-disk floor of the harness launch check: twice the largest run directory.

panels.title: Dispatch queue
panels.description: Slices queued, held and running. csf_dispatch_slices: Slices in the dispatcher's snapshot by state: queued, held and running.

panels.title: Dispatch limits: launches remaining
panels.description: Launches each bounded limit still allows. csf_dispatch_limit_remaining: Launches each bounded dispatch limit (harness, budget, rate) still allows, from the dispatcher's snapshot.

panels.title: Gate decisions per day
panels.description: Session gate decisions in the 24 hours before each point. csf_gate_decisions_total: Session gate decisions recorded in each run's events.jsonl, by gate (wait, ready, commit, reply) and decision.

panels.title: Reply-gate refusals per day, by rule
panels.description: Replies refused in the 24 hours before each point. csf_reply_gate_refusals_total: Replies the reply gate refused, counted once for each rule the refusal names (research_check, commitment).

panels.title: Host pressure and held resumes
panels.description: Whether the host stalls, and how many open runs a restart holds until admission frees. csf_host_pressure_some_avg10: Percent of the last 10 s in which some task waited for the resource (cpu, memory or io), from the kernel's pressure stall information. csf_resumes_held: Open runs the last restart still holds because the launch check does not admit them, from the resume queue.

panels.title: Struggles per 1k tool calls, this week
panels.description: The customer unit: it must fall. Backfilled points carry the rate measured through the previous day. csf_struggle_rate_per_1k_tool_calls: Struggle episodes (tool errors, permission denials, retries) per 1,000 tool calls over the current week or day of every run's events.jsonl (ouroboros.Struggles), with its 95% Garwood interval as bound low and high.

panels.title: Compounding factor of the struggle rate
panels.description: Below 1 the struggle rate is falling; the baseline to beat is x1.156 per week. csf_compounding_factor: Per-period factor of the struggle rate: exp of the struggle-weighted log-linear slope over the periods with at least one struggle and 200 tool calls, with its 95% interval; below 1 is improvement, and it needs 3 such periods.

panels.title: Prompt-cache hit ratio (h_fleet)
panels.description: scope=fleet is h_fleet; the other rows are per real session. csf_harness_cache_hit_ratio: Share of submitted input tokens read from the prompt cache.

panels.title: Prompt-cache writes
panels.description: Tokens written to the cache over every measured run. csf_harness_cache_creation_tokens: Input tokens written to the prompt cache.

panels.title: First-turn share of cache writes
panels.description: Where cold starts pay for the whole prefix. csf_harness_cache_first_turn_creation_share: Share of cache creation paid by first turns.

panels.title: Sessions measured for the cache
panels.description: Virtual sessions are runs; real sessions are executor conversations. csf_harness_cache_sessions: Virtual and real sessions measured.

panels.title: Routing decisions
panels.description: Whether a turn attached to a warm conversation or started fresh. csf_harness_routing_decisions: Routing decisions recorded, by arm and reason.

panels.title: Ontology alignment score
panels.description: Lower is better; each step is a merge. csf_ontology_alignment_score: Ontology alignment score after the latest merged pull request whose body reports one (the after value of its Ontology score line); lower is better.

panels.title: Ontology alignment signals
panels.description: The counts the score weighs. csf_ontology_alignment_signal: Count of each ontology alignment signal after the latest merged pull request whose body reports the signal table.

panels.title: Merges per day, by slice
panels.description: Pull requests merged into main in the 24 hours before each point. csf_merges_total: Pull requests merged into main, from GitHub's list of merged pull requests; slice is the title's leading slice name.

panels.title: Operator corrections per merged slice
panels.description: Always read beside merged slices per operator-attention hour, so it cannot be lowered by doing less or by asking more. The first point (2026-10-04 03:00Z to 2026-10-05 02:05Z, 15 corrections against 8 merged slices) is hand-labeled from #124 until AFFECT types corrections. csf_operator_corrections_total: Operator corrections: distinct mistakes the operator flagged, by class; source hand_labeled is the hand-labeled window in corrections.json, classed by the ticket or gate that owns the class; source affect is every correction pkg/affect reads, classed by its failure code (#417) once the ouroboros codes verb has coded it and uncoded until then. csf_merges_total: Pull requests merged into main, from GitHub's list of merged pull requests; slice is the title's leading slice name.

panels.title: Merged slices per operator-attention hour
panels.description: The other half of the pair: the hand-labeled window counts 7 attention hours. csf_merges_total: Pull requests merged into main, from GitHub's list of merged pull requests; slice is the title's leading slice name. csf_operator_attention_hours_total: Operator-attention hours: distinct UTC hours holding at least one operator-authored message, from the runs' send records (source runs) or hand-counted for the corrections.json window (source hand_labeled).

panels.title: Operator corrections, class $class
panels.description: One panel per class of correction, repeated over the class variable: the class names the failure code, gate or ticket that owns it, so a rising panel is a failing gate and the largest class is the next gate to build. csf_operator_corrections_total: Operator corrections: distinct mistakes the operator flagged, by class; source hand_labeled is the hand-labeled window in corrections.json, classed by the ticket or gate that owns the class; source affect is every correction pkg/affect reads, classed by its failure code (#417) once the ouroboros codes verb has coded it and uncoded until then.

panels.title: Questions to the operator per day, by verdict
panels.description: The question gate (#145) judges each question an agent asks. csf_harness_questions_total: Questions agents put to the operator, by the gate that judged them, their class and verdict.

panels.title: Refused questions the operator wanted
panels.description: A rising line is the question gate refusing what the operator wanted asked. csf_harness_question_overrides_total: Sends by which the operator said they wanted a question the question gate refused.

panels.title: Operator rulings: total and UNENFORCED (RULINGS)
panels.description: Every ruling in force and the ones no gate enforces; unenforced is driven to 0 by gating rulings, never by recording fewer. csf_rulings_in_force: Operator rulings in force, from the harness's ruling records, by whether a gate enforces them (enforced) or none does (unenforced).

panels.title: Hypervisor cost events per day, by operation
panels.description: How often each session operation happens. csf_hypervisor_cost_events_total: Hypervisor cost events (#353): one per session operation (warm or cold turn, bind, rebind, model flip, idle close, reopen, keep-alive), derived from every run's records by services/harness/costs, by operation.

panels.title: Hypervisor spend per day, by operation
panels.description: What each kind of session operation cost in the 24 hours before each point. csf_hypervisor_cost_usd_total: US dollars the hypervisor cost events (#353) price, at the per-model prices services/harness/costs fits from the record, by operation.

panels.title: Information density
panels.description: Plugs in when #348 lands. csf_information_density: Information density of a session's turns; no samples until slice #348 lands.

panels.title: Merge checks per day, by outcome
panels.description: Ready and merge actions run the merge path's checks. csf_merge_checks_total: Ready and merge control actions on sessions, each of which runs the merge path's checks, by outcome (ok, failed), from each run's events.jsonl.

panels.title: Bazel build wall time by arm (BAZEL-RAM)
panels.description: The A/B result: the spreads overlap, so nothing landed. csf_bazel_build_wall_seconds: Median wall seconds of a clean Bazel build of the Go tree by arm (A is the defaults), from BAZEL-RAM's lab entry docs/lab/2026-10-05-bazel-ram.md as lab.json records it.

panels.title: Bazel peak memory by arm (BAZEL-RAM)
panels.description: Sandbox trees in RAM cost memory and saved no time. csf_bazel_peak_memory_bytes: Median peak memory of a clean Bazel build of the Go tree by arm (A is the defaults), from BAZEL-RAM's lab entry docs/lab/2026-10-05-bazel-ram.md as lab.json records it.

panels.title: Cloud spend per hour (BURST-SESSIONS)
panels.description: Paid cloud jobs csf serve's cloud service launched, from <state>/cloud.json; spend is minutes since creation at the flavor's /api/jobs/hardware price, so it reads high, never low. csf_cloud_spend_usd_total: Spend of every cloud job in the record, in dollars; its rate is spend per hour.

panels.title: Cloud jobs running (BURST-SESSIONS)
panels.description: Each running job is watched every 30 s and cancelled at its cap and at the day's cap. csf_cloud_jobs_running: Cloud jobs that may still be spending.

panels.title: Cloud spend against cap (BURST-SESSIONS)
panels.description: The day's cloud spend against the day's cap, and each running job's spend against its own cap. csf_cloud_spend_today_usd: Spend of the cloud jobs created today (UTC), in dollars. csf_cloud_daily_cap_usd: The day's cap on cloud spend, in dollars. csf_cloud_job_spend_usd: One cloud job's spend so far, in dollars. csf_cloud_job_cap_usd: One cloud job's cap, in dollars.

panels.title: Burst sessions and merged pull requests per dollar (BURST-SESSIONS)
panels.description: A burst's merged pull requests are counted with gh once it ends; a running burst counts in sessions only. csf_cloud_burst_sessions_total: Fixer sessions launched in burst jobs. csf_cloud_burst_pull_requests_merged_total: Pull requests merged from ended burst jobs. csf_cloud_burst_spend_usd_total: Spend of ended burst jobs whose merged pull requests are counted, in dollars: the denominator of pull requests per dollar.

panels.title: Queue length and work in progress, by stage (LINE)
panels.description: Slices per stage of the line; running is the work in progress. csf_dispatch_stage_slices: Slices in each stage of the line, from the dispatcher's snapshot: ready, blocked, contended, running, merged, failed, canceled.

panels.title: Time in stage, oldest slice (LINE)
panels.description: How long the oldest slice in each stage has waited there. csf_dispatch_stage_age_seconds: Seconds the oldest slice in each stage has stood there since its state last moved, from the dispatcher's snapshot.

panels.title: Lead time, enqueue to merge (LINE)
panels.description: Mean lead time of the slices merged in the last day. csf_dispatch_lead_time_seconds: Mean seconds from enqueue to merge of the slices merged in the last day, from the dispatcher's snapshot; absent when none merged.

panels.title: Throughput: merges per day (LINE)
panels.description: Pull requests merged into main in the 24 hours before each point, every slice together. csf_merges_total: Pull requests merged into main, from GitHub's list of merged pull requests; slice is the title's leading slice name.

panels.title: Transcript settle time per event (TRANSCRIPT)
panels.description: Median and 95th percentile over five minutes of how long a session's event takes to reach the chat pages watching it. csf_chat_settle_seconds: Seconds from an event log record's timestamp to a connected chat page's live session accepting it, per record: how long a session's event takes to reach its transcript.

panels.title: Build score on the held-out suite (EVAL-SUITE)
panels.description: Each build csf eval score scored, on the suite version it was scored on; lower is better, and csf upgrade refuses a build with no score or one worse than live beyond the paired bound. csf_eval_struggle_rate_per_1k_tool_calls: A csf build's score on the held-out evaluation suite: struggle episodes per 1,000 tool calls over its replays at the suite's budget, with the 95% Garwood interval as bound low and high.

panels.title: Wall-clock to score a build (EVAL-SUITE)
panels.description: How long one build's score took end to end, across every shard. csf_eval_score_wall_seconds: Wall-clock seconds to score a build: from the first replay launched to the last recorded.

panels.title: Cost per build score (EVAL-SUITE)
panels.description: The model cost of one build's replays, summed over its shards. csf_eval_score_cost_usd: Dollars to score a build: the model cost of its replays.

panels.title: Shards per node (EVAL-SUITE)
panels.description: Where a build's replays ran: this host, or a cloud burst job (a dry run when the burst credentials are missing, its replays then run here). csf_eval_shards: Replays of a build's score run on each node kind: this host or a cloud burst job.

panels.title: GitHub events per hour by kind (GITHUB-EVENTS)
panels.description: Typed events the webhook receiver recorded in each hour, one series per kind. csf_github_events_total: Typed GitHub events this host's receiver recorded on the GitHub event stream since it started, by kind.

panels.title: GitHub event latency by kind (GITHUB-EVENTS)
panels.description: How long after GitHub says each kind's latest event happened it landed on the stream; a merge should read seconds. csf_github_event_latency_seconds: Seconds from when GitHub says the latest event of each kind happened to when this host recorded it as a typed event.

panels.title: GitHub deliveries refused or failed per hour (GITHUB-EVENTS)
panels.description: Deliveries the receiver did not accept in each hour: refused (with why: no secret, bad signature, bad delivery, too large) or failed to record. csf_github_deliveries_total: GitHub webhook deliveries this host's receiver answered since it started, by outcome (accepted, duplicate, ignored, refused, failed) and, for a refused one, why.
